# teams_call_hold_policy (Resource)

Manages the CallHoldPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsCallHoldPolicy / Get-CsTeamsCallHoldPolicy / Set-CsTeamsCallHoldPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsCallHoldPolicy.
